summary: Clackamas County ground site: a USFS 10x10 cab built 1933 on a minor point west of Wests Butte, listed as an emergency lookout in 1946, gone by 1968.

facts.design: 10'x10' cab on a minor point; listed as a ground site
facts.status_note: Cab gone by 1968; no source describes what remains at the point

events.note: USFS constructed a 10'x10' cab on a minor point 1-1/2 miles west of Wests Butte
Listed as an emergency lookout on the 1946 Mt. Hood National Forest map
Gone by 1968 (register); 'Gone 1968' (firelookout.com). Exact removal date not given.
Registered August 17, 2010 as US 579, OR 20; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: ground site in Clackamas County (Forest Lookouts list)
evidence.quote: Buckskin Point Clackamas 45.06662 -121.71903 Ground Gone FFLOS US 579, OR 20

evidence.supports: about 21 miles south of Mount Hood

evidence.quote: In 1933, the USFS constructed a 10'x10' cab atop a minor point 1-1/2 miles west of Wests Butte.

evidence.supports: administered by the U.S. Forest Service

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com agree on 45.06662, -121.71903, which the brief uses. A third record in our crawl, from the Forest Lookouts map, gives 45.0621, -121.7154, about half a kilometre away. The story gives no coordinates.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the three pages agree on the 1933 build and the 1968 end, but no staffing, fire history or present-day description was found, so those are left out. The access key is omitted because no source describes access. The 1954 photo and the 1946 map listing are the only other items. The Forest Lookouts coordinate record for this site differs from the register by about half a kilometre; the brief's coordinates were kept.
